messages.author: d6da36e2f4b0f4c3
messages.subject: Locale error while deploying app
parts:
Hello: I have seen this issue several times on this forum, but the solutions didn't work.

When I deploy the app, I get this message:

  building: Processing bundle: 185786
  error: Parsing manifest
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 33435118 failed: Error parsing manifest: Unsupported locale: da_DA.UTF-8



When I do: 
shinyapps:::detectLocale.Windows(FALSE)

I get
Detecting system locale ... da_DA
[1] "da_DA"


Actually, this is wrong, because when I do:
Sys.getlocale()
[1] "LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252;LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252;LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252;LC_NUMERIC=C;LC_TIME=English_United States.1252"

Also after sessionInfo()
R version 3.0.3 (2014-03-06)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252  LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252   
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252 LC_NUMERIC=C                          
[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252    

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
 [1] ggplot2_1.0.0     repmis_0.4.2      rDrop_0.3-0       plyr_1.8.1       
 [5] ROAuth_0.92.0     digest_0.6.4      RCurl_1.95-4.5    RJSONIO_1.2-0.2  
 [9] stringr_0.6.2     FRACTION_1.0      httpuv_1.3.2      nnet_7.3-9       
[13] caTools_1.17.1    bitops_1.0-6      shinyapps_0.3.64  shiny_0.11.1.9005

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
 [1] colorspace_1.2-4  data.table_1.9.2  grid_3.0.3        gtable_0.1.2     
 [5] htmltools_0.2.6   httr_0.6.1        MASS_7.3-33       mime_0.3         
 [9] munsell_0.4.2     proto_0.3-10      R.cache_0.10.0    R.methodsS3_1.6.1
[13] R.oo_1.18.0       R.utils_1.34.0    R6_2.0.1          Rcpp_0.11.1      
[17] reshape2_1.4      scales_0.2.4      tools_3.0.3       xtable_1.7-3     

So, what should i do to solve this issue?

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Locale error while deploying app
parts:
You can override the locale by doing

options(shinyapps.locale = 'en_US') 

or 

options(shinyapps.locale = 'da_DK')
